scope: Run one frozen shuffled shard of the development-only dispatch sweep.

spec.scope: Synthetic development-only operator dispatch calibration; no heldout or end-to-end claim
spec.candidate: frozen RawPairPaddedPlan, original B-derived S, all copies and raw-state/tail work included
spec.primary_baseline: production native XQA PDL-on, same Q/KV and physical page table
controls: first and last request independent FP64

policy_search.family: B>=min_batch AND P>=min_prefix AND max_actual_private_tokens/P<=max_private_prefix_ratio; B<=4 always native
policy_search.admissible: All covered development cells must pass correctness, native_AA median ratio in[0.98,1.02], and paired bootstrap lower95>=1.03; at least8 cells spanning at least2 prefixes and2 batches
policy_search.objective: Maximise number of covered development cells; ties maximise worst lower95, then choose larger min_batch, larger min_prefix, smaller ratio
policy_search.runtime: Only current batch, physically shared prefix length and maximum current private length; no timing, lookahead or output-length oracle
policy_search.heldout: Freeze selected parameters and policy source before separate seed/off-grid prefix-tail-batch validation; failures restrict or reject the policy without reporting retuned heldout gains

limitations: Synthetic development data only, no heldout, no natural generation or E2E.
Hot complete-call graphs; policy cannot be claimed cold-cache robust from this sweep alone.
Private length includes current token and varies from 75% to100% of the declared additional tail.
